scenes.heading: Editable Templates Fundamentals
scenes.narration: Templates. Editable Templates Fundamentals. In this video we review 7 key concepts you need to know for the certification.

scenes.question: What is an AEM template?
scenes.heading: A pre-defined structure and initial content that can be used to quickly create a new site
scenes.body: An AEM template is a pre-defined structure and initial content that can be used to quickly create a new site, eliminating the need to start from scratch and ensuring sites are consistent with branding and design standards.

scenes.question: Where were AEM templates historically stored in the repository?
scenes.heading: In the /apps folder of the AEMaaCS installation
scenes.body: AEM templates are stored in the /apps folder of the AEMaaCS installation, in a new folder created for the template, with files and folders determining the site's structure and content.

scenes.question: What capability do editable page templates give specialized authors?
scenes.heading: The ability to create, update, and manage advanced policy configurations for page templates
scenes.body: Editable page templates in AEM Sites provide specialized authors with the ability to create, update, and manage advanced policy configurations for page templates, offering a flexible, customizable framework for designing pages.

scenes.question: What do editable templates define to let content authors customize a page?
scenes.heading: Editable regions where content authors can modify specific areas while the rest stays locked to the template
scenes.body: Editable templates allow authors to define editable regions within the template, letting content authors modify and customize specific areas while maintaining consistency and adherence to branding guidelines elsewhere.

scenes.question: What are the three main advantages of using editable templates for new AEM sites?
scenes.heading: Increased author productivity, improved consistency, and reduced development costs
scenes.body: Editable templates increase author productivity by letting authors create/update templates without developers, improve consistency since all pages share the same policies and settings, and reduce development costs by avoiding custom code for every page variation.

scenes.question: What does the Layout Container policy configure?
scenes.heading: Configuring allowed components, drag-and-drop asset mapping, and the number of responsive grid columns
scenes.body: The Layout Container policy allows you to configure the allowed components, manage the drag-and-drop mapping of assets, and set the number of responsive grid columns for that container.

scenes.question: Where can you find Editable Templates in the AEM Sites console?
scenes.heading: Tools > General > Templates in the AEM Sites console
scenes.body: Editable Templates can be found under Tools > General > Templates in the AEM Sites console, or locally at http://localhost:4502/libs/wcm/core/content/sites/templates.html/conf.
